titleEn: How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Vancouver? Real Timelines from 18 Projects

contentEn:
A standard bathroom renovation in Vancouver takes 2 to 8 weeks from demolition to final cleanup, depending on scope. Based on 18 completed Reno Stars projects across Greater Vancouver in 2025-2026, the median timeline is 3-5 weeks for a full renovation in a house or townhouse, and 2-4 weeks in a condo.

Every project listed here is a real Reno Stars job with verified timelines, space types, and budgets — not averages or estimates. Read on to find the timeline that matches your situation.

What Affects Your Bathroom Renovation Timeline in Vancouver

Three factors determine how long your bathroom reno will take in Metro Vancouver:

  • Scope of work — A shower-to-bathtub swap takes 2-3 weeks; converting one bathroom into two can require 9-11 weeks.
  • Property type — Condos require building council approvals for any plumbing work, adding 3-7 days. Houses and townhouses move faster.
  • Material lead times — Custom glass enclosures, imported tile, and specialty fixtures can add 1-4 weeks. Standard finishes from local suppliers are available within days.

How Vancouver Building Permits Affect Your Timeline

Most bathroom renovations in Vancouver proper do not require a building permit if the work does not change the structure or plumbing rough-in. A permit is required when:

  • You are moving or adding plumbing fixtures (adding a second sink, moving a toilet)
  • The work involves structural changes to walls or floor joists
  • You are converting a powder room into a full bath with a shower

When a permit is required, add 2-4 weeks for the City of Vancouver or your municipality to process the application. Reno Stars handles permit applications as part of our standard project management service.

How to Speed Up Your Bathroom Renovation in Vancouver

Several choices can compress your timeline without sacrificing quality:

  • Choose in-stock finishes — Standard porcelain tile, chrome fixtures, and white quartz vanity tops are available within days from Metro Vancouver suppliers. Custom imported marble or specialty fixtures can require 4-6 weeks.
  • Approve materials quickly — Delays in material selection are the most common cause of timeline overruns. Having your selections ready before demo begins saves 1-2 weeks.
  • Allow parallel trades — Skilled Reno Stars project managers sequence demolition, plumbing, and tiling to overlap where safe, compressing total duration.

See real project examples at Minimalist Bathroom Renovation in Richmond and Luxury Curbless Shower Bathroom Renovation in North Vancouver.

Frequently Asked Questions About Bathroom Renovation Timelines in Vancouver

How long does a small bathroom renovation take in Vancouver?

A small or cosmetic bathroom renovation — replacing a vanity, retiling a shower, updating fixtures — takes 1-3 weeks in a Vancouver house or condo. Reno Stars has completed multiple projects in this range, including a Minimalist Bathroom Renovation in Richmond that finished in under three weeks.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Vancouver?

You need a permit when plumbing is relocated, new fixtures are added, or structural changes are made. Simply retiling, replacing a vanity, or refinishing a bathtub does not require a City of Vancouver permit. Condos may require building council approval regardless of scope. Reno Stars manages all permit applications.

What is the longest part of a Vancouver bathroom renovation?

Tile work and grout curing typically takes the longest — 3-7 days for a standard bath, longer for custom layouts. Custom glass enclosures and specialty fixtures ordered from Vancouver suppliers require 1-3 weeks of lead time before installation can begin.

Can I live in my home during a bathroom renovation?

Yes, in most cases. A single-bathroom home requires a temporary solution (portable shower, alternate bathroom) for 1-3 weeks during demo and plumbing. Multi-bathroom homes can remain fully occupied throughout the project.

How much does a full bathroom renovation cost in Vancouver?

Based on 18 completed Reno Stars projects in 2025-2026, a full bathroom renovation in Metro Vancouver ranges from $14,000 to $60,000. Condo renovations tend to fall in the $14,000-$20,000 range; house and townhouse full renovations typically run $22,000-$45,000. High-end custom builds with imported materials can exceed $55,000.

What is the average timeline for a master bathroom renovation?

A master bathroom renovation in a Vancouver house or condo takes 3-5 weeks for a full gut renovation including new plumbing, tiling, custom features, and premium fixtures. Luxury master baths with imported tile, custom glass, and high-end fixtures require 5-8 weeks. See Luxury Curbless Shower Bathroom Renovation in North Vancouver as a completed example.
